2c3e215087ea6c3235763582ed2e20a7a80517da  deliberate, not portable: fix/brush-subshell-exit-trap (reubeno/brush#1540) lived in vendored brush-core, which upstream 44711a78c1b deleted. The new engine already runs a child context's own EXIT trap (5 of the member's 6 cases pass at ff0a986b, addon e0b028c6), but it still gets the sixth wrong: `( trap ': ${nope?boom}' EXIT; exit 4 ); echo $?` prints 1 where Bash 5.2.21 and 5.3.0 print 4, and 127 at top level. The new VM sends `exit N` and a fatal expansion error through the same Flow::Exit into exit_shell (pi-shell bash/vm/exec.rs), so the fix needs a new fatal-or-exit split on every fatal path: new upstream work, not a port, now owned by the ShellPortAudit lane as an upstream defect (evidence /mnt/durable/sami/ForkPastEngineSwap/exit-trap-main.log, fatal-trap-variants-main.log)
